verdict.rationale: The docs explicitly describe moving from the OpenAI SDK by changing the base URL, key and model ID. They document OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and speech-to-text compatibility with Bearer auth, and the llms.txt probe confirms published OpenAI base URLs. Swapping the model ID is inherent to switching providers rather than an extra integration step. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an unmodified OpenAI SDK client works end-to-end against the endpoint.
